    reg signed [31:0] sum_pipe0;
    reg signed [31:0] sum_pipe1;
    integer i;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
                d[i] <= 16'sd0;
            sum_pipe0 <= 32'sd0;
            sum_pipe1 <= 32'sd0;
            y_out <= 32'sd0;

            d[0] <= x_in;

                       + ((d[4]*C4 + d[5]*C5) + (d[6]*C6 + d[7]*C7));
            sum_pipe1 <= sum_pipe0;
            y_out <= sum_pipe1;
        end
    end
